qs.en: The Prime Minister appointed a new ministerial adviser in charge of foreign relations.

qs.en: He carried out his ministerial duties for five years without any scandal.

qs.en: She felt a cold anger rising in her in the face of the injustice.

qs.en: The crowd's fury erupted when the referee disallowed the goal.

qs.en: The stray dog was put in quarantine because rabies was suspected.

qs.en: You need to get vaccinated against rabies before travelling to certain parts of Asia.

qs.en: To access the services, you must complete the registration of your user account.

qs.en: The baggage check-in at the airport opens three hours before departure.

qs.en: You can do your check-in online to avoid the queues at the counter.

qs.en: The technician produced a very high-quality recording.

qs.s: ___ enregistrement de cette réunion est conservé dans les archives.
qs.en: The recording of this meeting is kept in the archives.
